theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ₁ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → 0 < ρ₁ → closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D → ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume (symmDiff ((fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F) {w | 0 < inner ℝ w v} ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, inner ℝ (g (r⁻¹ • (z - y))) (ν z) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z in ((Submodule.span ℝ {v})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), inner ℝ (g z) v ∂μHE[m]))
